place_media_leitura_publica.name: place_media_leitura_publica
place_media_leitura_publica.using: exists (select 1 from place p where p.id = place_id and p.status = 'published')

editorial_review_leitura_publica.name: editorial_review_leitura_publica
editorial_review_leitura_publica.using:
status = 'published'
        and exists (select 1 from place p where p.id = place_id and p.status = 'published')

offer_leitura_publica.name: offer_leitura_publica
offer_leitura_publica.using:
status = 'active'
        and (valid_from is null or valid_from <= now())
        and (valid_until is null or valid_until > now())
        and exists (select 1 from place p where p.id = place_id and p.status = 'published')

offer_valid_range.name: offer_valid_range
offer_valid_range.value: "offer"."valid_until" is null or "offer"."valid_from" is null or "offer"."valid_until" > "offer"."valid_from"

subscription_active_period.name: subscription_active_period
subscription_active_period.value: "subscription"."status" <> 'active' or ("subscription"."starts_at" is not null and "subscription"."ends_at" is not null and "subscription"."ends_at" > "subscription"."starts_at")

redemption_emissao_da_propria_pessoa.name: redemption_emissao_da_propria_pessoa
redemption_emissao_da_propria_pessoa.withCheck: user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and status = 'issued' and redeemed_at is null and operator_id is null

redemption_cancelamento_da_propria_pesso.name: redemption_cancelamento_da_propria_pessoa
redemption_cancelamento_da_propria_pesso.withCheck: user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and status = 'voided' and redeemed_at is null and operator_id is null
